theme_and_archetype.description: Dark neo-noir city vibe with gritty/neon accents. Clean, readable dashboard RPG. Deepest void black base with high-contrast neon accents for metrics, timers, and alerts. Conveys a sense of gritty city life, money pressure, and survival.

typography.fonts_installation: Add via Google Fonts in index.html: Unbounded, Manrope, JetBrains Mono.

headings.usage: H1, H2, Player Level, Primary Stats, Section Titles. Apply 'tracking-tighter' for large text.

body.usage: General UI text, labels, descriptions, cards. Highly legible for dense MMO interfaces.

mono.usage: Event logs, timers, countdowns, financial numbers. Essential for the 'terminal/hacker' neo-noir feel. Always use 'tabular-nums' utility.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. Dense, data-heavy, scanable.
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Use p-6 to p-8 for main layout containers to breathe.
layout_and_spacing.item_gap: Use gap-4 for dense widgets, gap-8 for distinct sections.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and logs. Center-align major level-up moments or primary CTAs.

cards.style: Technical Grid Look. Flat background (bg-[#121212]), 1px solid border (border-white/10). No soft shadows, use sharp edges or max 4px radius (rounded-sm).
cards.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle neon inner shadow or border highlight (hover:border-[#00F3FF]/50).

progress_bars.style: Sharp corners. Height 8px-12px. Background bg-white/5. Border 1px border-white/10.
progress_bars.fill: Gradient based on stat. Health: red to pink. Energy: purple to cyan. Fatigue/Stress: yellow to red.

event_log.style: Retro-Futurism/Terminal Look. bg-[#050505], border-l-2 border-[#00FF66]/50, font-mono (JetBrains Mono), text-sm. Recent events brightest, older events faded (opacity).

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#00F3FF] text-[#00F3FF] hover:bg-[#00F3FF] hover:text-black uppercase tracking-widest font-bold transition-all px-4 py-2
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 px-4 py-2 uppercase tracking-wide text-sm
buttons.danger: bg-transparent border border-[#FF0055] text-[#FF0055] hover:bg-[#FF0055] hover:text-white uppercase tracking-wide text-sm

badges.style: Small, sharp-edged rectangles (rounded-none or rounded-sm). bg-opacity-10 with 1px border matching text color. Used for risk levels, duration, costs.

motion_and_interaction.timers: Use fixed-width numerals (tabular-nums) to prevent layout shifting during countdowns.

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight, matched to accent colors for active states, muted for inactive. Perfect for dense dashboards.

image_urls.description: Dark neo-noir city street at night. Use with heavy bg-black/80 overlay for login/register screen or main city backdrop to set the moody RPG tone.
Rainy neon city street. Excellent for 'Downtown', 'Job Center' or 'Real Estate' module backgrounds. Always use a dark gradient overlay.
Neon arrows pointing up/right. Great header image for leaderboard, stock market, or business upgrade section.
Neon sign with Asian writing. Good for shop background, black market, or shady alleys.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements, buttons, links, form inputs, menus, error messages, user balances, progress bars and confirmation text MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='start-job-button'`, `data-testid='health-bar'`). Use kebab-case, role-based names.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA (at least 4.5:1 for normal text). Do not use pure black backgrounds without slightly tinting or layering. Use text-shadow over images.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serifs for headings. Use 'Unbounded'.
DO NOT use generic Vercel/Shadcn rounded styling. Aggressively customize Shadcn components: remove soft shadows, make edges sharp (rounded-none or rounded-sm), use matte backgrounds.
Implement the 'MODE B: CONTROL ROOM GRID' layout. The dashboard must feel dense, data-rich, and use every pixel efficiently. Use cards for Job selection, Courses, and Real Estate listings.
All components must be coded in pure React + Tailwind CSS (.js or .jsx format, NOT .tsx).
Ensure the Event Log looks like a terminal output (mono font, dark bg, text colors mapping to event severity).
Avoid fully transparent headers or sections; use a backdrop-blur with a dark tint (`bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-md`).
Implement `data-testid` on all interactable elements and stat displays without fail.
